text_en: Never give in, never give in, never, never, never - never give in except to convictions of honour and good sense.
text_cn: 永不屈服，永不屈服，绝不、绝不、绝不——除非是为了荣誉与良知的信念，否则绝不退让。
author: Winston Churchill
note: 五个 never give in 排比递进，except to 引出唯一例外；可仿写 never ... except when ...。

text_en: What I must do is all that concerns me, not what the people think.
text_cn: 我必须做的事才是我唯一关心的，至于别人怎么想，我并不在意。
author: Ralph Waldo Emerson
note: What I must do 为主语从句，all that 引导定语从句；可仿写 What matters is ..., not ...。

text_en: If you have built castles in the air, your work need not be lost; that is where they should be. Now put the foundations under them.
text_cn: 如果你在空中建造了城堡，你的努力未必白费；城堡本就该建在空中，现在只需为它打下地基。
author: Henry David Thoreau
note: castles in the air 意为空中楼阁；need not be lost 语气委婉，末句祈使句收束有力。

text_en: Optimism is the faith that leads to achievement; nothing can be done without hope and confidence.
text_cn: 乐观是通向成就的信念；没有希望与信心，任何事都做不成。
author: Helen Keller
note: faith that leads to achievement 为定语从句；nothing can be done without 用双重否定加强肯定。

text_en: Education is the most powerful weapon which you can use to change the world.
text_cn: 教育是你能用来改变世界的最强大的武器。
author: Nelson Mandela
note: which you can use 为后置定语从句；可仿写 X is the most powerful weapon with which ...。

text_en: Courage is resistance to fear, mastery of fear, not absence of fear.
text_cn: 勇气是对恐惧的抵抗，是对恐惧的掌控，而不是毫无恐惧。
author: Mark Twain
note: resistance to 与 mastery of 均为名词搭配，not absence of fear 否定收尾；可仿写 X is not A but B。

text_en: Our doubts are traitors, and make us lose the good we oft might win by fearing to attempt.
text_cn: 我们的疑虑是叛徒，因害怕尝试，让我们失去本可赢得的种种好处。
author: William Shakespeare
note: doubts are traitors 用暗喻；oft 是 often 的缩略，by fearing to attempt 表原因与方式。

text_en: A journey of a thousand miles begins with a single step.
text_cn: 千里之行，始于足下。
author: Lao Tzu
note: begins with 用具体动作说明抽象道理；可仿写 A journey of ... begins with a single ...。

text_en: Dost thou love life? Then do not squander time, for that is the stuff life is made of.
text_cn: 你热爱生命吗？那就别浪费时间，因为生命正是由时间构成的。
author: Benjamin Franklin
note: Dost thou 为古体疑问式，squander 意为挥霍；for 引导原因，be made of 指由材料构成。

text_en: You may not control all the events that happen to you, but you can decide not to be reduced by them.
text_cn: 你也许无法掌控发生在自己身上的一切，但你可以决定不被它们击垮。
author: Maya Angelou
note: may not control ... but you can decide 构成让步转折；be reduced by 用被动表被击垮。

text_en: How wonderful it is that nobody need wait a single moment before starting to improve the world.
text_cn: 多么美好啊，谁都不必等上一刻就能开始让世界变得更好。
source: The Diary of a Young Girl
author: Anne Frank
note: How wonderful it is that 为感叹句加主语从句；need wait 中 need 作情态动词，后接动词原形。

text_en: The time is always right to do what is right.
text_cn: 做正确的事，任何时候都是好时机。
author: Martin Luther King Jr.
note: right 前后重复形成警句节奏；不定式 to do what is right 作定语修饰 the time。

text_en: The only thing we have to fear is fear itself.
text_cn: 我们唯一需要恐惧的，就是恐惧本身。
author: Franklin D. Roosevelt
note: fear 一词首尾重复，直指恐惧本身；the only thing we have to fear 定语从句省略了 that。

text_en: Life is not easy for any of us. But what of that? We must have perseverance and above all confidence in ourselves.
text_cn: 生活对我们谁都不轻松。但那又怎样？我们必须有毅力，尤其要对自己有信心。
author: Marie Curie
note: But what of that? 用短问句承接上文；above all 表递进，confidence in oneself 为固定搭配。

text_en: The best time to plant a tree was twenty years ago. The second best time is now.
text_cn: 种一棵树最好的时间是二十年前，其次是现在。
author: 佚名
note: 用两个时间点对比，含蓄劝人立即动手；可仿写 The best time to ... was ..., the second best is now。

text_en: When one door closes, another opens; but we often look so long and so regretfully upon the closed door that we do not see the one which has opened for us.
text_cn: 一扇门关上时，另一扇会打开；但我们常常久久地、懊悔地盯着那扇关上的门，以致看不见为我们打开的那一扇。
author: Alexander Graham Bell
note: look so ... that 构成结果状语从句；the one which has opened 用 one 避免重复 door。

text_en: Success is to be measured not so much by the position that one has reached in life as by the obstacles which he has overcome.
text_cn: 衡量成功，与其看一个人在生活中达到的位置，不如看他克服了哪些障碍。
author: Booker T. Washington
note: not so much by ... as by ... 为比较结构；which he has overcome 定语从句修饰 obstacles。

text_en: When we are no longer able to change a situation, we are challenged to change ourselves.
text_cn: 当我们再也无法改变处境时，就应该接受挑战去改变自己。
author: Viktor E. Frankl
note: be challenged to do 用被动表被要求、被推动；when 从句与主句形成情境对照。

text_en: To see what is right and not to do it is want of courage.
text_cn: 看到该做的事却不去做，就是缺乏勇气。
author: Confucius
note: 两个并列不定式作主语，谓语用 is；want 在此为名词，意为缺乏，不是想要。

text_en: It is not enough to be busy; so are the ants. The question is: What are we busy about?
text_cn: 仅仅忙碌是不够的，蚂蚁也很忙碌。问题在于：我们究竟在忙些什么？
source: Letter to H. G. O. Blake, 1854
author: Henry David Thoreau
note: not enough to be busy 先否定，so are the ants 用倒装类比，末句设问收束全段。
